title: 第十五章 千万剑一剑第十六章 东海来人
lines: 一道金光闪耀的剑痕，渐渐消失在王贤的神海之中，也消失在王若望的眼前。
来自天山的纳兰明，并没有一剑落空，就此罢手。
而是一声怒喝，再斩一剑，直指身前十丈的老道士。
瞬间睁开双眼的王贤，看到了这一道剑痕。
应该说，他从漫天飘落的雪花反射的光芒里，看到了一道，二道，无数道剑痕！
好像三月柳絮一样，在他眼前渐渐多了起来。
他有些迷惑了，这家伙为何不是一剑斩向师父？
而是玩起了花样？在风雪中织一张剑网，要将师父网住不成？
天空落下的雪花越来越多，王贤眼里的剑痕也越来越清晰。
他想发出一声呼喊，可是他却什么都没有做。
因为师父没有动。
看在王贤眼里，这只是一刹那发生的事情。
但是在王若望看来，为了眼前这一剑，师兄纳兰明已经等待了太久，远不止十年的时间。
就像纳兰明一边斩出风中一剑，一边在等待。
等待他斩出的无数道剑痕，要么化为惊天一剑，要么化为一道剑阵，将老道士困死其中。
王贤想不明白，眼前这个来自天山的长老，为何能斩出无数道剑？
他只是想到师父说的那些道理，想着自己有一天，能不能斩出眼前这样的漫天剑气？
最后化为这风中落下的雪花，不留下任何痕迹。
他甚至在想，师父肯定不会跟这老头一样，胡乱斩出漫天的剑痕！
换成是他，只会斩出一剑！
老道士悠悠叹了一口气，不知是高兴，还是失望，还是在警告王贤，不要为对方无数剑痕所迷惑。
他非常清楚，自己站在这里，纳兰明便不可能万剑合一！
唯一的可能，便是这家伙想要织一道剑阵！
在自己不能使出符道之下，用剑阵将自己困死！
望着风雪中的千道剑痕，突然说道：“还不够，远远不够！”
就在纳兰明挥剑之际，欲要万剑合一的刹那，老道士出手了！
不是因为他害怕这道剑阵，他要让王贤明白一个道理，该出手时，就得出手，不要给对手任何先机！
万剑成阵，是纳兰明苦思冥想无数年，在天山练就的最强一剑！
当年他败在老道士剑下，在天山困苦了无数年。
终有一天，在天池边顿悟之际，开始修炼这一招万剑合一......
就算被老道士刹那打断，他还能将这万剑化为一座囚笼，这是他的明算。
他没想过输，也没想能赢了老道士。
在纳兰明看来，只能将老道士困上哪怕一刻钟的光景，也能消除他这些年在心里积下的怨气。
然而，这只是他的想法，不是老道士的。
老道士手掌微颤，一道若有若无的剑气，刹那斩出。
看在王若望的眼里，当下的老道士怕是不敌师兄这招，身子止不住前倾，似有力竭之意，怕是要被这一剑所伤。
一声剑鸣，拖着长长的尾音。
听在王贤的耳中，却是风雪中有千百道剑骤然对斩，瞬间发出一阵铿锵的碰撞声！
看在纳兰明眼里，面前的老道士明明只是斩出了一剑！
便是这简单的一剑，看在他的眼里，却有千万道剑光，往他而来！
content_en:
A sword mark with shining golden light gradually disappeared into Wang Xian's divine sea and disappeared before Wang Ruowang's eyes.
Nalan Ming, who came from Tianshan, did not stop with his sword.
Instead, he yelled angrily and slashed with his sword, pointing directly at the old Taoist priest ten feet in front of him.
Wang Xian opened his eyes instantly and saw this sword mark.
It should be said that he saw one, two, and countless sword marks in the light reflected from the falling snowflakes in the sky!
Like willow catkins in March, they gradually appeared in front of his eyes.
He was a little confused. Why didn't this guy slash at the master with one sword?
But playing tricks? Can you weave a sword net in the wind and snow to trap the master?
More and more snowflakes fell from the sky, and the sword marks in Wang Xian's eyes became clearer and clearer.
He wanted to shout, but he did nothing.
Because the master didn't move.
In Wang Xian's eyes, this just happened in an instant.
But in Wang Ruowang's opinion, senior brother Nalan Ming had waited too long for the sword in front of him, much more than ten years.
Just like Nalan Ming was waiting while slashing his sword in the wind.
The countless sword marks waiting for him to strike would either turn into a shocking sword strike, or turn into a sword array, trapping the old Taoist priest to death.
Wang Xian couldn't understand why the elder from Tianshan in front of him could slash countless swords?
He just thought about the principles his master said, and wondered if one day he would be able to cut out the sword energy in front of him.
In the end, it turned into snowflakes falling in the wind, leaving no trace.
He was even thinking that the master would definitely not be like this old man, making sword marks all over the sky randomly!
If it were him, he would only be able to slash out with one sword!
"Alas!"
The old Taoist priest sighed leisurely, whether he was happy, disappointed, or warning Wang Xian not to be confused by the opponent's countless sword marks.
He knew very well that if he stood here, it would be impossible for Nalan Ming to unite all his swords into one!
The only possibility is that this guy wants to weave a sword array!
When he couldn't use the talismans, he used the sword array to trap himself to death!
Looking at the thousands of sword marks in the wind and snow, he suddenly said: "It's not enough, far from enough!"
Just when Nalan Ming was swinging his sword and wanted to unite all the swords into one, the old Taoist priest took action!
It's not because he's afraid of this sword formation. He wants Wang Xian to understand a truth: when it's time to take action, you have to take action and don't give your opponent any chance!
...
The formation of ten thousand swords is the strongest sword that Nalan Ming has practiced in Tianshan for countless years!
Back then, he was defeated by the sword of an old Taoist priest and suffered in hardship in Tianshan for countless years.
One day, when I had an epiphany by the Tianchi Lake, I began to practice this technique of combining ten thousand swords into one...
Even if he was interrupted by the old Taoist priest, he could still turn these ten thousand swords into a cage. This was his clear plan.
He never thought about losing, nor did he think about defeating the old Taoist priest.
In Nalan Ming's view, trapping the old Taoist priest for even a quarter of an hour could eliminate the resentment he had built up in his heart over the years.
However, this is just his idea, not the old Taoist priest's.
The old Taoist priest's palm trembled slightly, and a faint sword energy was slashed out in an instant.
In Wang Ruowang's eyes, the old Taoist priest was afraid that he would not be able to defeat his senior brother's move. He could not stop leaning forward, as if he was exhausted, and was afraid that he would be injured by this sword.
"Zheng..."
There was a sword cry, with a long tail sound.
In Wang Xian's ears, there were thousands of swords suddenly slashing at each other in the wind and snow, and there was a sonorous collision sound in an instant!
In Nalan Ming's eyes, the old Taoist priest in front of him clearly just slashed out with one sword!
It was this simple sword strike, but in his eyes, there were thousands of sword lights coming towards him!
title_en: Chapter 15: Thousands of Swords, One Sword Chapter 16: People from the East China Sea
